newsitem.title: CHINA: China brokers to meet to discuss B share trading.
newsitem.headline: China brokers to meet to discuss B share trading.

text.p: Brokers from China's main brokerages will meet on Friday afternoon to discuss ways to curb domestic investors trading on the foreign currency B share market, brokerage sources said.
They said the meeting was organised in Shanghai by the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC), the top securities watchdog, but details of the meeting are not yet known.
The meeting is expected to have a negative impact nn the B share market, already under heavy pressure from other factors.
A spokesman for the CSRC declined to comment.
